info.title: Chunkify analytics collector API
info.description: Collect playback events, query analytics, and manage your project.

servers.description: Default local development address. Replace with your HTTPS collector origin.

get.description: Check whether the service is ready.

503.description: The service is busy or temporarily unavailable.

get.description: List project events with filters and pagination. Use order=desc for the newest events.

200.description: Event page; next_cursor is null at the end.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

post.description: Send one playback event using a public key. Success confirms storage completed.

200.description: Local storage only: this event ID already exists in the project; its first payload and context are preserved.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Present only on accepted browser ingest/preflight requests. Exact allowed origin; never a wildcard.

201.description: The event finished storage. S3 also returns this response for repeated event IDs.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Present only on accepted browser ingest/preflight requests. Exact allowed origin; never a wildcard.

400.description: Malformed JSON or event; unsupported schema/name or missing required field.

403.description: Origin or preflight is not allowed.

413.description: Request size exceeds the configured limit.

429.description: Ingestion rate exceeded. Retry after the indicated delay.

503.description: The service is busy or temporarily unavailable.

options.description: Check whether a browser origin can send playback events.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Optional browser origin. When supplied it must exactly match server.allowed_origins. Origin-less server requests are allowed with the public key.

204.description: Browser may submit a POST using the listed headers.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Present only on accepted browser ingest/preflight requests. Exact allowed origin; never a wildcard.

403.description: Origin, method or requested headers are not allowed.

get.summary: Read totals for a view cohort
get.description: Get views, unique viewer IDs, and playing time for matching playback attempts. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name or device_type. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

get.description: List per-video totals. Sort the entire filtered cohort by video_id, views or total_playing_time_ms before pagination. sort_by defaults to video_id and order defaults to asc. Metric ties use video_id ascending in either direction. Unique viewer counts cannot be added across videos. Keep sort_by, order and filters unchanged with a cursor.

200.description: Video page; next_cursor is null at the end.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

get.summary: Read hourly or daily metrics by view start
get.description: Get hourly or daily totals in UTC. Playing time belongs to the view start bucket. Returns at most 1000 buckets.

200.description: Complete UTC start-cohort series, including empty buckets.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

get.summary: Read playback quality for a view cohort
get.description: Get startup time, buffering, and observed fatal errors for matching playback attempts. Null means unavailable. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name or device_type. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups.

200.description: Playback-quality metrics and sample counts for selected starts.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

500.description: Storage operation failed or a numeric aggregate exceeded the finite response range.

get.summary: Read average watch time and reached-end rate
get.description: Get average watch time per attempt and the observed reached-end rate. Reaching the end does not prove the whole video was watched. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name or device_type. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups.

200.description: Engagement for the selected playback attempts.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

500.description: Storage operation failed or a numeric aggregate exceeded the finite response range.

publicKey.name: X-Chunkify-Ingest-Key
publicKey.description: Public key starting with ck_public_. Use it in the player to send events.

secretKey.description: Private key starting with ck_secret_. Full-access keys read analytics and manage one project. Read-only private keys access analytics and MCP only. Keep all private keys out of browser code.

adminKey.description: Installation admin key from COLLECTOR_ADMIN_KEY. Creates projects.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time lower bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event. Must be before to.

to.name: to
to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time upper bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event.

video_id.name: video_id
video_id.description: Exact video ID. Combined with all other filters using AND.

viewer_id.name: viewer_id
viewer_id.description: Exact supplied viewer ID. Missing/null viewer IDs do not match.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: Raw-event queries only. Summaries and videos reject this parameter.

browser_name.name: browser_name
browser_name.description: Exact browser name, such as Chrome. Missing values do not match.

os_name.name: os_name
os_name.description: Exact operating-system name, such as macOS. Missing values do not match.

device_type.name: device_type
device_type.description: Exact device class. unknown matches an explicit unknown value.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum rows on this page. Events and videos always support pagination; summary, quality and engagement support it only with group_by.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Use next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same filters, sort_by and order. Video cursors from earlier versions are invalid; start a new pagination sequence after upgrading.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional browser origin. When supplied it must exactly match server.allowed_origins. Origin-less server requests are allowed with the public key.

identity_encoding.name: Content-Encoding
identity_encoding.description: JSON requests accept an absent Content-Encoding header or identity. Compression is not supported.

timeseries_from.name: from
timeseries_from.description: Inclusive view-start time in RFC3339 format with a timezone.

timeseries_to.name: to
timeseries_to.description: Exclusive view-start time in RFC3339 format with a timezone. Must be later than from.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: UTC hour or day. The requested range can contain at most 1000 buckets.

order.name: order
order.description: Sort direction, defaulting to asc. Events sort by server ingestion sequence; videos sort by sort_by. Video metric ties use video_id ascending in either direction. Keep the same order with each cursor.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: Videos only. Rank all matching videos by this field before pagination. Watch time is total_playing_time_ms. Metric ties use video_id ascending. Keep the same sort_by with each cursor.

group_by.name: group_by
group_by.description: Optional on summary, quality and engagement. Group views by this field on their first retained start. Missing, null and nonstring context forms a null group; the literal device type unknown stays separate. Groups sort by value ascending, null first. Pagination is available only with group_by.

AnalyticsEvent.description: A schema version 1 playback event. Extra properties are preserved.

peer_ip.description: Direct TCP peer IP, canonical IPv4 or IPv6.

client_ip.description: Request sender IP, using trusted proxy information when available. May identify a gateway.

EventContext.description: Browser and request context for the event. Fields can be absent or null.

project_id.description: Trusted project identifier resolved from the public key. Historical events migrate to default.

ingest_key_id.description: ID of the public key used to receive this event. Null when unavailable.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

bytesValue.description: Only an explicit null is accepted; non-null bytesValue attributes are unsupported.

OtlpAttributeValue.description: A typed log attribute. At most one value field can be set. Binary values are unsupported.

OtlpAttribute.description: An absent or null key decodes to the empty string; duplicate decoded keys reject the request. An absent value decodes to null.

OtlpAnyValue.description: Standard OTLP AnyValue in a preserved resource, scope or body. This collector does not decode these fields into the event.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

OtlpLogRecord.description: A playback event in log attributes. Duplicate attributes and invalid event fields reject the request.

StoredOtlpContext.description: Legacy context present for an event received through OTLP by an earlier collector version. Existing context remains readable; new ingestion accepts native JSON events only.

bucket_start.description: UTC interval start in RFC3339 with milliseconds and Z. May precede from in a partial first bucket; only starts inside [from, to) contribute.

from.description: Inclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

to.description: Exclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed attempts.

sample_views.description: Views with a non-null startup measurement on the selected final event or latest snapshot.

median.description: Continuous median startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

p95.description: Continuous 95th percentile startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

startup_time_ms.description: Time from attempt to first playing, measured once per eligible view. This is not first-frame timing.

sample_views.description: Views with playing and rebuffer durations available and positive combined duration.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Sum of playing time for eligible buffering samples only.

total_rebuffer_duration_ms.description: Sum of rebuffer time for the same samples.

ratio.description: Total rebuffer time divided by combined playing and rebuffer time. Null without samples. Multiply by 100 for percent.

buffering.description: Duration-weighted buffering. Startup wait, pauses and seeking are excluded by the SDK. Unknown durations are not treated as zero.

affected_views.description: Distinct selected views with at least one observed matching fatal playback_error, including before playback starts.

ratio.description: Affected views divided by all selected attempts; null when views is zero. Multiply by 100 for percent.

fatal_errors.description: Observed fatal errors. Lost events can undercount this metric; absence of an error is not proof of successful playback.

Quality.description: Playback quality for the same start cohort as summary. All rates are fractions. Counts expose measurement coverage.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed, ongoing and start-only attempts.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Cumulative playing time summed once per selected view, as in summary.

average_playing_time_ms.description: Total playing time divided by all selected attempts. Null with no views; zero when views exist with no measured time.

reached_end_views.description: Views whose winning final event has reason=ended. Counts each selected view at most once.

reached_end_ratio.description: Reached-end views divided by all selected attempts. Null without views. Multiply by 100 for percent. Does not imply the whole video was watched.

Engagement.description: Observed watch time and end-of-media for the same start cohort as summary. Missing delivery can undercount both.

read_only.description: True for a private key limited to analytics reads through HTTP and MCP. Public keys always report false. Rotation preserves this setting.

key.description: New key value. Save it now; it is returned once.

read_only.description: True for a private key limited to analytics reads through HTTP and MCP. Public keys always report false. Rotation preserves this setting.

allowed_origins.description: Additional project origins. Shared TOML origins are always included.

secret_key.description: Secret key for this project. Save it now; it is returned once.
